Facts: Operator of forklift without certification, operating forklift, wood veneer slipped, hit a worker, causing death. This is a workplace accident leading to death due to negligence. Potential charges: "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) or "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent dangerous method endangering public safety) or "重大责任事故" (major responsibility accident) or "失火" (no fire). The list includes "过失致人死亡" and "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". Also "重大责任事故" is used for large industrial accidents with many casualties, but here only one death. The earlier example: forklift accident? In earlier example: "付肖某" driving loader, hit motorcyclist, death. The answer given: "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". They gave two charges: negligent homicide and damage to production operation. That case involved a construction site, causing death. They added "破坏生产经营". In our case, forklift operation in a factory causing death. Could be "过失致人死亡". Also maybe "破坏生产经营"? The earlier example included "破坏生产经营" because the accident caused damage to production? Not sure. The list includes "破坏生产经营". The forklift accident may have caused damage to production? Not mentioned. So likely just "过失致人死亡". Also maybe "危险驾驶"? No, forklift not vehicle on road. "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" is for dangerous methods causing public safety risk, like using dangerous equipment unsafely. Could apply. But typical charge for workplace death due to negligence is "过失致人死亡". In Chinese criminal law, article 133 (negligent homicide). So answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡<eoa>.
